title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom towel storage with a wall mount towel ring crafted from solid brass and sized at a 6-inch diameter for daily hand towels.

  • Coordinates easily: Part of the Foxtrot collection for a pulled-together look with matching pieces.
  • Space-smart layout: Wall-mounted design keeps towels accessible while helping save space.
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting helps maintain a streamlined appearance.
  • Hardware included: Ships with the towel ring and all installation hardware.
  • Built for everyday use: Solid brass construction.

Specs

  • Type: Towel ring
  • Collection: Foxtrot
  • Shape: Round
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Diameter: 6 inches
  • Projection: 2 inches
  • Overall size (L x W x H): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Foxtrot Collection Towel Ring
_previous.description: The contemporary motif from this elegant collection has timeless appeal. Towel ring is constructed of solid brass and is an ideal six inches in diameter. It is ideal for displaying your favorite decorative towels or for providing the space for daily use.
